description: This line plot, titled "Search Space of M-Cube," illustrates the number of possible solutions as a function of the number of missing pieces, with two distinct lines representing whether a flip is needed or ignored. The x-axis, labeled "# Missing pieces," uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 6, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled "# Possible solutions," uses a logarithmic scale spanning from 10² to 10⁸, with tick marks at powers of ten. The orange line, labeled "Flip needed," begins at approximately 10² possible solutions when 1 piece is missing and increases to 10⁸ when 6 pieces are missing, showing a steep upward trend with data points at approximately 10², 10³, 10⁴, 10⁵, 10⁶, and 10⁸. The blue line, labeled "Flip ignored," starts at approximately 10² when 1 piece is missing and rises to approximately 10⁶ when 6 pieces are missing, with data points at approximately 10², 10³, 10⁴, 10⁵, and 10⁶. A red circle highlights the point on the orange line at 6 missing pieces, labeled "CUBE-easy," and another red circle highlights the point on the blue line at 3 missing pieces.
